description: Accepted-track A104 cell grids: cycle-time stills, observed-frame stills for cells without a cycle, and full-length smoothed videos

settings.still_crop: own observed frame, tight, intensity-weighted centroid, resized to grid slot
settings.still_cycle_selection: highest-amplitude eligible cycle; no eligible cycle omits row only from still image
settings.video_crop: own-cell tight crop, fixed size per cell across time, filled 128-pixel grid tile; five-frame centre smoothing and 5% of crop short-side movement threshold
settings.observed_supplement: six evenly spaced frames with an observed mask per excluded cell; Obs 0-5 headers, actual source hours in report
settings.video_absent_mask: timeline continues at native frame cadence; unavailable mask indicated in its tile

verification.checks: output receipt hashes, ffprobe source frame parity, six observed-mask frames per supplementary cell, calibrated bars
